paper.title_en: Post-Inflationary Constraints on Nonminimally Coupled Quintessential Inflation
paper.abstract_en: We investigate quintessential inflation in a nonminimally coupled scalar-tensor theory, parameterizing the post-inflationary radiation abundance independently of the reheating mechanism. The nonadiabatic inflation-kination transition generates a stochastic gravitational-wave background whose contribution to $ΔN_{\textrm{eff}}$ imposes a lower limit on the reheating temperature. Because this temperature dictates the duration of kination and the available scalar-field excursion, it directly constrains the present-day dark-energy equation of state. While a single-exponential coupling achieves the required post-inflationary potential drop, the same constant slope does not provide viable late-time acceleration. A double-exponential deformation resolves this tension by decoupling the average slope governing the total potential drop from the asymptotic slope driving cosmic acceleration. Full numerical solutions confirm this picture, yielding a thawing quintessence regime with $w_{φ,0}\simeq (-0.90, -0.95)$ for our benchmarks. Our results demonstrate that future dark-energy measurements can directly probe the post-inflationary reheating history of the Universe.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究了非最小耦合精髓暴胀，并连接了随机引力波背景、再加热温度和暗能量状态方程，与PTA主题相关，并提供了具体的数值结果和约束。
decision.title_zh: 非最小耦合的精髓暴胀的后暴胀约束
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了非最小耦合标量-张量理论中的精髓暴胀，独立于再加热机制参数化了暴胀后的辐射丰度。非绝热暴胀-动能转变产生了一个随机引力波背景，其对$\Delta N_{\textrm{eff}}$的贡献对再加热温度施加了一个下限。由于该温度决定了动能时期的持续时间和可用的标量场位移，它直接约束了当今暗能量状态方程。虽然单指数耦合实现了所需的暴胀后势能下降，但相同的恒定斜率并不能提供可行的晚期加速。双指数变形通过将控制总势能下降的平均斜率与驱动宇宙加速的渐近斜率解耦来解决这一矛盾。完整的数值解证实了这一图景，为我们的基准产生了具有$w_{\phi,0}\simeq (-0.90, -0.95)$的解冻精髓态。我们的结果表明，未来的暗能量测量可以直接探测宇宙的暴胀后再加热历史。
